rules.rule: Record explicit user scope approval before implementation; replan material changes.
Host filesystem, execution and network permissions remain binding.
Publishing, messaging, and destructive actions require applicable user authorization.
Only declared outcomes and budgeted edges can execute.
Record criterion status, commands, results, and code revision; unknown is not passed.
Read task-specific context; stop after two unsuccessful repair attempts and report blockers.
Choose patterns for demonstrated constraints; record decision IDs, rationale, alternatives and tradeoffs; assess reuse and deliver small testable slices.
V5 requires structured design planning, implementation decision coverage/performance assessment, and engineering review checks.
Treat 10x productivity as a goal; claim gains only with a comparable recorded baseline and observed results.
Assess material proposals independently; explain stance, compare realistic options and lifecycle costs, mark uncertainty, and honor informed authorized user decisions.
